decision.question: Should a city authorize a bounded congestion-pricing pilot with equity, accessibility, privacy, appeal, and transit-reinvestment controls?
decision.baseline: Continue current traffic-management and transport arrangements without congestion pricing.

escalation_triggers: traffic displacement materially harms vulnerable neighborhoods
emergency or disability access is impaired
camera or billing data use expands
transit capacity or reinvestment commitments are not carried

evidence_and_claim_boundary.reality_surface: A synthetic city transport-policy case covering drivers, low-income commuters, disabled travelers, neighborhoods, emergency services, transit agencies, enforcement and appeals functions, and environmental effects.

evidence_trace.description: Illustrative traffic, transit, emissions, accessibility, and household-burden baseline
Illustrative legal, privacy, due-process, disability-access, and enforcement review
Illustrative stakeholder consultation and subgroup-impact record

evidence_and_claim_boundary.transition_or_action_boundary: Select among no change, an unqualified flat charge, or a time-bounded pilot with exemptions, accessibility support, transit reinvestment, appeal, privacy controls, monitoring, and stop/revision authority.
consequence_pathways: household cost and access to work
evidence_and_claim_boundary.claim_boundary: Synthetic public-policy reference replay only. It is not evidence that congestion pricing is lawful, effective, equitable, politically legitimate, or suitable for any real city.

parameters.name: pilot_duration_months
parameters.source: illustrative authority choice fixed before ranking

parameters.name: formal_rls_numeric_score
parameters.not_material_rationale: No calibrated city-specific cell scores or probabilities are claimed.

parameter_lock.amendment_policy: Any material change creates run version 1.1 and reopens all affected stages.

stakeholders.description: Low-income commuters, disabled travelers, caregivers, shift workers, and residents with constrained alternatives
Residents and businesses in priced and diversion-affected neighborhoods
Transit, emergency, enforcement, appeals, privacy, and municipal finance institutions
Wider population, climate, air-quality, and biosphere interests

options.description: No policy change; continue current traffic-management and transport arrangements.
Introduce a flat congestion charge without protected-group exemptions, guaranteed transit reinvestment, independent appeal, or strengthened privacy controls.

Authorize a twelve-month pilot with low-income and disability accommodations, emergency-access safeguards, transit reinvestment, privacy minimization, independent appeal, neighborhood-displacement monitoring, published review, and stop/revision authority.

gate_results.rationale: The status quo is a selectable option, with its own congestion, access, health, and environmental harms carried into ranking.
Discriminatory burden, access, due process, privacy, and appeal protections are unresolved; aggregate efficiency or emissions benefit cannot compensate.
Only the controlled pilot configuration is selectable, subject to carried exemptions, accessibility, appeals, privacy, transit, monitoring, and stop obligations.

ranking.decisiveness_rule: Illustrative qualitative ranking only; uncertain diversion, uptake, transit-capacity, equity, and legitimacy effects prevent a deterministic framework-selection claim.
ranking.summary: C may produce the better residual ripple if protections and reinvestment work; A remains preferable under adverse diversion, access, burden, privacy, or administrative evidence.

decision_state.rationale: A bounded pilot can test benefits and harms while preserving a no-action fallback and review path.
decision_state.authority_selection_rationale: A lawfully constituted city authority could select a reversible, rights-screened pilot after public process; the framework does not claim unique selection or confer legal authority.

authority_and_execution.mandate_scope: May select a bounded pilot only after separate legal, budgetary, procurement, privacy, accessibility, and public-process requirements are satisfied.
authority_and_execution.appeal_path: Independent exemptions and penalties appeal; public challenge and review; judicial or regulatory routes determined separately.
authority_and_execution.revocation_path: Authorized city body may suspend or terminate the pilot when rights, access, privacy, transit-capacity, diversion, legitimacy, or control conditions fail.

controls_monitoring_and_reopen.shutdown_or_pause_path: Suspend or narrow charging and enforcement if access, rights, privacy, transit-capacity, diversion, or control thresholds fail; preserve the no-action fallback and targeted non-charge measures.
reopen_triggers: traffic displacement materially harms vulnerable neighborhoods
emergency or disability access is impaired
camera or billing data use expands
transit capacity or reinvestment commitments are not carried

consequence_tempo.trigger_rationale: Illustrative bounded pilot; reopen if propagation speed, automation, irreversibility, emergency conditions, or lock-in becomes material.

responsibility_continuity.decision_authority: City transport authority subject to lawful mandate and public process
responsibility_continuity.operational_responsibility: Transport agency and designated delivery partners
responsibility_continuity.execution_authority: Separate lawfully empowered implementation authority; not yet issued
responsibility_continuity.intervention_authority: Named transport, accessibility, privacy, emergency-service, and independent review officials
responsibility_continuity.remedy_owner: City authority with independent appeals and affected-agency duties
responsibility_continuity.residual_responsibility: City and legally accountable public bodies

material_obligations.obligation: Maintain the exemptions, accessibility, emergency access, appeal, privacy, transit-reinvestment, monitoring, and stop controls constitutive of Option C.
material_obligations.accountable_authority: City transport authority with independent oversight
material_obligations.operational_carrier_or_execution_path: Named transport operations, exemptions, appeals, privacy, accessibility, transit, and evaluation roles
material_obligations.authority_and_capacity_basis: City transport authority with independent oversight has the declared mandate, resources, stop authority, access to records, and escalation route for this bounded illustrative case.
material_obligations.activation_trigger: The selected pilot is approved for activation or a control exception is detected.
material_obligations.scope: Declared pilot zone, duration, affected populations, data systems, enforcement rules, and reinvestment commitments
material_obligations.required_action: Verify that protections are active before charging, monitor subgroup impacts and errors, correct or remedy failures, and suspend or redesign when thresholds are crossed.
material_obligations.response_deadline_or_window: Before activation and immediately upon a material exception.
material_obligations.evidence_of_discharge: Published control checklist, exemption and appeal records, accessibility and emergency-service confirmation, privacy log, reinvestment ledger, monitoring report, and stop/redesign record.
material_obligations.review_or_expiry: Review at each scheduled checkpoint; expires at pilot end or on any material configuration, evidence, authority, or environment change.
material_obligations.challenge_route: Affected person appeal, protected staff challenge, public review, and applicable legal/regulatory routes.
material_obligations.delegation_acceptance: Any delegate must explicitly accept the duty in the controlled role register before carrying it.
material_obligations.backup_or_successor: Named deputy authority and pre-authorized fallback operators for each critical function.
material_obligations.nonperformance_trigger: Missing evidence of discharge, unavailable carrier, unresolved exception, missed response window, or loss of authority/capacity.
material_obligations.missed_duty_escalation: Suspend the affected operation, preserve evidence, provide interim access/remedy, notify oversight, and reopen RG/RF/TRC/CSV before continuation.
material_obligations.amendment_waiver_suspension_retirement_a: City transport authority with independent oversight with independent reviewer sign-off; the operating carrier may not self-waive.
material_obligations.change_control_rule: Any material amendment, waiver, suspension, or replacement must be logged and independently reviewed; changed conditions reopen affected MathGov stages.
material_obligations.residual_responsibility: The deploying institution retains residual responsibility and may not transfer it to a vendor, contractor, or automated system.

human_compensation_load.trigger_rationale: The pilot requires real administrative and care work for exemptions, appeals, accessibility, enforcement correction, consultation, and public explanation; it must not be hidden as frictionless automation.
human_compensation_load.hidden_work_and_workflow_gap: Case handling and remedy work can disappear from efficiency claims while being essential to rights-safe operation.
human_compensation_load.single_person_dependency: No single official may hold the only complete knowledge or authority for exemptions, appeals, privacy incidents, or shutdown.
human_compensation_load.consequence_if_compensation_stops: People may lose access, incorrect penalties may persist, privacy incidents may remain unresolved, and the controlled option may hollow into a flat charge.
human_compensation_load.privacy_and_non_retaliation_controls: Confidential staff reporting, protected affected-person data, aggregate publication, independent oversight, and no retaliation for stopping or challenging the pilot.
human_compensation_load.preservation_or_redesign_action: Resource the carrier roles, automate only clerical tasks, preserve human appeal and remedy, cap pilot scale, and suspend expansion when workload or recovery limits fail.
human_compensation_load.review_trigger: Any activation, scaling, staffing reduction, automation change, repeated override, backlog, or material burden/recovery signal.

configuration_assurance.configuration_summary: Synthetic twelve-month congestion-pricing pilot with protected-group accommodations, emergency safeguards, transit reinvestment, privacy limits, independent appeal, neighborhood monitoring, public review, and stop/revision authority.
configuration_assurance.operating_envelope: Declared pilot zone and period, specified charge and exemptions, fixed data uses and retention, bounded enforcement, monitored transit and diversion capacity, and explicit stop conditions.
